notes: A tall card on a blue-to-cream gradient with a navy header showing the Vibe Prospecting logo and 'Authorization Request'. It says 'MCP Consents is requesting access to your Vibe Prospecting account' and lists three abilities: pull data from the account, run searches and enrichments with the user's credits, and stay connected until disconnected. Below are a Continue with Google button, an email field, and an image CAPTCHA ('Enter the code shown above') before a 'Sign in and allow access' button, so consent happens in the same step as sign-in. A terms and privacy line closes the card. The image CAPTCHA adds typing friction.
